$wt = "E:\AI\PersonalAgentOS_Claude_Autonomous_Build_Package_v1\.claude\worktrees\team\d20261001\worker-stt-engines-measure"
$py = Join-Path $wt "services\api\.venv\Scripts\python.exe"
$scratch = Join-Path $env:TEMP "sttm-run"
if (Test-Path $scratch) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $scratch -Confirm:$false }
$rec = Join-Path $scratch "kayit"; $ev = Join-Path $scratch "evidence"
Push-Location (Join-Path $wt "services\api"); & $py (Join-Path $wt "services\api\_mk_scratch.py") $rec; Pop-Location
# dummy keys in this process: the script leaves the caller's environment alone and reads NOTHING from the secret store;
# -Engines chrome-web-speech selects no engine that can run, so no audio is sent anywhere.
$env:PAGENTOS_VOICE_OPENAI_API_KEY = "dummy-not-a-key"; $env:PAGENTOS_VOICE_SONIOX_API_KEY = "dummy-not-a-key"; $env:PAGENTOS_VOICE_AZURE_SPEECH_KEY = "dummy-not-a-key"
$script = Join-Path $wt "scripts\voice\stt-compare.ps1"
"--- run 1 (-File)"; powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $script -Folder $rec -EvidenceDir $ev -Python $py -Engines chrome-web-speech | Select-Object -Last 3; "exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
"--- run 2 (typed name)"; & $script -Folder $rec -EvidenceDir $ev -Python $py -Engines chrome-web-speech | Select-Object -Last 3; "exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
# take every timestamped name of the next 3 minutes: the run must find a free one, not replace
$t = Get-Date; 0..180 | ForEach-Object { $n = "stt-compare-" + $t.AddSeconds($_).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd-HHmmss") + ".json"; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $ev $n), "earlier evidence") }
$taken = (Get-ChildItem $ev -Filter *.json | Where-Object { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw) -eq "earlier evidence" }).Count
"--- run 3 (timestamped name taken; $taken placeholders)"; powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $script -Folder $rec -EvidenceDir $ev -Python $py -Engines chrome-web-speech | Select-Object -Last 3; "exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
"--- run 4 (again)"; & $script -Folder $rec -EvidenceDir $ev -Python $py -Engines chrome-web-speech | Select-Object -Last 3; "exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
$still = (Get-ChildItem $ev -Filter *.json | Where-Object { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw) -eq "earlier evidence" }).Count
"placeholders intact: $still of $taken"
Get-ChildItem $ev | Where-Object { $_.Length -ne 16 } | Select-Object Name, Length | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String
